_what: How this page gets its pass to the account's one door (account-pass.ts): the sign-in tool's OAuth code flow with PKCE, this page being the client its own client document names (CIMD; scripts/build-workspace.mjs writes the document at `client_document` for each origin it is built for). `scope` is the words the page asks for, each one the authorization server offers; `sharing.*` lets the owner keep, list and withdraw a grant on their own door from this page (sharing.keep, sharing.list, sharing.withdraw), which no other credential of theirs carries. `kept` is the sessionStorage name the code verifier and the state wait under across the one redirect. `renew_before_ms`: a pass that ends sooner than this is renewed before a call.
scope: openid profile email offline_access tools:list tools:* sharing.*
refused: Signing in did not finish. Sign in again.
busy: Sign-in is busy right now. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
